children: China will apply a 20% individual income tax to dividends and bonuses that foreign individuals receive from foreign enterprises in China, according to a finance ministry statement on Tuesday.
The policy takes effect from Tuesday and ends foreign individuals' exemption from such tax under previous policies released in 1994.
